description: This is a PHP class file for an OpenCart admin controller handling backup operations such as listing, creating, restoring, uploading, downloading, and deleting database backups.

classes.name: Backup
classes.description: Controller class for managing database backup operations in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Sets up the backup management page with necessary data and views.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Retrieves a list of backup files from the storage directory and formats their details for display.

methods.name: backup
methods.description: Creates a backup task based on selected tables, ensuring permission checks.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Queues a restore task for a specified backup file, with permission and file existence validation.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Handles uploading of SQL backup files with validation for filename length and file type.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Streams the specified backup file to the user for download, with permission checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified backup file after permission validation.
